about: Generated by scripts/build_references.py. All model nodes use model:<feature ID>. verification is strict placement status; photoVerification and checked-against retain photographic diagnostics separately. Only placement-verified-by edges grant placement approval within their stated tolerance. Open discrepancies block approval. Earlier manual reviews are not erased. Record validation does not inspect pixels or authenticate reviewer identity.

nodes.notes: User reports BARRAKA BEACH planter is in the wrong place. Current [35,122] is an estimate; exact correction has not been independently measured. Earlier reviews and passing clearance tests do not establish this position.

Green aisle is immediately left/northeast of actual Barraka looking seaward; previous southwest run anchors the whole planter arrangement on the wrong flank. Draft candidate moves aisle/planter by [+1,-20]m; exact ground trace/endpoints remain unapproved. See independent review. No closure inferred from software checks or owner side identification.
nodes.reportedBy: Project owner clarification, independently checked against originals and maps

nodes.notes: Draft bounded stone rectangle improves the observed material but ends and width are estimates, concealed in aerial shade/vegetation. Complete physical corner controls/held-out registration and full-vertex measurements are unavailable; current Eva crossing disagrees with the continuous photographed corridor. No <=2m approval or resolution of earlier south-gate photo disagreement.

Photo shows a tall east hedge continuing inward from the gate. Draft includes only gate-side fragment, stopping clear of retained Eva route. Source does not establish an actual hedge gap at that route, nor independently measured endpoints. Continuation/route relationship remains unresolved.

Source-relative tunnel draft has no world-map transform. Existing material mask/phone GPS do not register the full entrance, side recesses or garden exit. Owner authorized guessed recess depth/generic concealed doors, not a surveyed global footprint. Register identifiable corners/connections before placing this component on the resort map.

Approximate west-side main-map integration candidate is compatible with registry portal/courtyard topology. EXIF heading disagrees; opposite northeast host remains possible. No identified source controls or measured approval. Existing world-registration report remains open.

Owner suspects gate, bench and planter are too close to pool. Independent satellite/photo assessment confirms planted lawn/approach buffer, but foliage and roof projection conceal exact ground gate/bench anchors. Current model water-ring distance: gate7.58m; bench front centre6.49m. These are model diagnostics, not source measurements. No translation applied; retain as unresolved.

Gate, open right leaf, planter and wall bench now come in the photo's order: about 1.7 m of planter behind the leaf, then the bench recess and tiled wall, then more planter. Before, the bench sat 0.1-1.1 m from the gate, directly behind the open leaf. Still different: the model shows lawn either side of a crossing tiled path where the photo shows a narrow crazy-paved forecourt with a tall hedge on the left.
nodes.reportedBy: Claude (Dave's review of the live site)

nodes.notes: The same stored camera/subject and Details view now show continuous stone through the foreground and a gate-side east hedge, replacing lawn/crossing terracotta in the bounded patch. The photo shows a longer continuous hedge/corridor; the estimated Eva crossing is retained and leaves an unresolved interruption. Patch ends/width are estimated, adjacent model frontage differs, and the third-person camera has uncalibrated eye height/pitch/intrinsics. Do not claim a photographic or measured placement match.
